framework: Next.js 16+ (Latest, App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Lenis)
summary: Monorepo transformation complete. 3 workspace apps (@gesturify/web, @gesturify/docs, @gesturify/admin) built and verified with Turborepo.

workspaces.name: @gesturify/web
workspaces.purpose: Real-time Indian Sign Language (ISL) browser interpreter using rear camera, MediaPipe, ONNX, and Web Speech.

workspaces.name: @gesturify/docs

workspaces.name: @gesturify/admin
workspaces.purpose: Admin telemetry and log intelligence dashboard summarizing component health, camera errors, model fallbacks, and real-time logs.
